scope: Exploratory physical-scale observations for two leaves already grouped as Codex 1505; no new attribution.

body.value: Two selected four-red-rule music systems are visible. Manual center rows [407,434,462,490] and [566,594,622,650], calibrated with the photographed 20 cm vertical ruler, yield approximate mean line intervals 5.584 mm and 5.651 mm. Arithmetic and exact coordinates are in the E21 result file.

annotations.verification: Source-linked; no independent repeat measurement or specialist review
interpretation_limits: Approximate scale; ruler endpoints and staff-line centers were selected manually.
Perspective, page waviness, local parchment deformation and ruling curvature are not corrected.
The measured pitch is a page-layout observation, not a book, hand or workshop identifier.
